title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第十三章、大胆的猜想

    包拯和公孙策在查看记录时发现了问题。冷宫的那场火灾，内班院的记录是死了二十三人，但太医院的记录是只找到二十具尸体，少了两名女子和一名太监。
    包拯说：“火灾发生时，楚珠应该在冷宫。如果死的宫女里有楚珠，那她的珠花怎么会出现在无人岛呢？带八王爷去无人岛的女人是谁？八王爷为什么要跟她去无人岛？他们认识吗？如果认识，她为什么要绑架八王爷呢？”
    “你觉得是无人岛的那个女人绑架了八王爷？”公孙策问。
    包拯点头道：“在看到珠花和那封信后，我相信是那个女人绑架了八王爷。”
    公孙策想了想，问道：“所以，你怀疑楚珠没有死，她就是那个女人？”
    “只是怀疑，没有证据。我们还可以大胆一点猜想，火灾现场少的两名女子都没有死，她们一个是楚珠，一个是埋在无人岛那个没有名字的坟墓里的人。”
    “啊！”公孙策惊叫出声，马上说道：“还有一种可能！”
    “什么？”
    “尸体里还少了一名太监，那个坟墓里埋的也可能是那个太监！”
    “那里只有一个房间，应该是两名女子。”
    “你说得有道理。那太监去哪儿了？”
    “明天去宫里看看当年的宫门出入记录，说不定有发现。”
    第二天，包拯和公孙策入宫门。
    这一次就没有昨天那么顺利了，好像是宫门口的侍卫得到了谁的命令，不能让包拯入宫。包拯和公孙策说了半天，侍卫也没同意让他们进去。
    正不知道怎么办的时候，包拯看到了一个熟人，他心中一喜。
    “卫大人！快来帮帮忙！”
    皇宫侍卫总管卫宁正好从宫门内经过，听到包拯的叫声，他马上走了过来。
    “包大人，怎么了？”
    “卫大人，我要见皇上，快带我进去！”
    卫宁马上明白是怎么回事了。他看了一眼侍卫，大声道：“包大人是为皇上办事的人，怎么可以阻拦？”
    “是张公公让我们……”侍卫小声解释。
    “张怀？他让你们阻拦你们就阻拦了？你们是听张怀的，还是听皇上的？”
    侍卫害怕得要哭了，冷汗马上流了一头。
    “算了，他也是没办法。走走走，带我去个地方。”包拯拉着卫宁往里走，公孙策抬腿跟了上去。
    “去哪儿？你不是要见皇上吗？”卫宁好奇道。
    “改变主意了，带我去你工作的侍卫营坐坐，我想向你借个本子看看。”
fullText.traditional:
第十三章、大膽的猜想

    包拯和公孫策在查看記錄時發現了問題。冷宮的那場火災，內班院的記錄是死了二十三人，但太醫院的記錄是只找到二十具屍體，少了兩名女子和一名太監。
    包拯說：“火災發生時，楚珠應該在冷宮。如果死的宮女裡有楚珠，那她的珠花怎麼會出現在無人島呢？帶八王爺去無人島的女人是誰？八王爺為什麼要跟她去無人島？他們認識嗎？如果認識，她為什麼要綁架八王爺呢？”
    “你覺得是無人島的那個女人綁架了八王爺？”公孫策問。
    包拯點頭道：“在看到珠花和那封信後，我相信是那個女人綁架了八王爺。”
    公孫策想了想，問道：“所以，你懷疑楚珠沒有死，她就是那個女人？”
    “只是懷疑，沒有證據。我們還可以大膽一點猜想，火災現場少的兩名女子都沒有死，她們一個是楚珠，一個是埋在無人島那個沒有名字的墳墓裡的人。”
    “啊！”公孫策驚叫出聲，馬上說道：“還有一種可能！”
    “什麼？”
    “屍體裡還少了一名太監，那個墳墓裡埋的也可能是那個太監！”
    “那裡只有一個房間，應該是兩名女子。”
    “你說得有道理。那太監去哪兒了？”
    “明天去宮裡看看當年的宮門出入記錄，說不定有發現。”
    第二天，包拯和公孫策入宮門。
    這一次就沒有昨天那麼順利了，好像是宮門口的侍衛得到了誰的命令，不能讓包拯入宮。包拯和公孫策說了半天，侍衛也沒同意讓他們進去。
    正不知道怎麼辦的時候，包拯看到了一個熟人，他心中一喜。
    “衛大人！快來幫幫忙！”
    皇宮侍衛總管衛寧正好從宮門內經過，聽到包拯的叫聲，他馬上走了過來。
    “包大人，怎麼了？”
    “衛大人，我要見皇上，快帶我進去！”
    衛寧馬上明白是怎麼回事了。他看了一眼侍衛，大聲道：“包大人是為皇上辦事的人，怎麼可以阻攔？”
    “是張公公讓我們……”侍衛小聲解釋。
    “張懷？他讓你們阻攔你們就阻攔了？你們是聽張懷的，還是聽皇上的？”
    侍衛害怕得要哭了，冷汗馬上流了一頭。
    “算了，他也是沒辦法。走走走，帶我去個地方。”包拯拉著衛寧往裡走，公孫策抬腿跟了上去。
    “去哪兒？你不是要見皇上嗎？”衛寧好奇道。
    “改變主意了，帶我去你工作的侍衛營坐坐，我想向你借個本子看看。”

sentences.pinyin: suàn le tā yě shì méi bàn fǎ zǒu zǒu zǒu dài wǒ qù ge dì fang
sentences.english: “Forget it, he had no choice either. Let’s go, take me somewhere else.”

sentences.simplified: 包拯拉着卫宁往里走，公孙策抬腿跟了上去。
sentences.traditional: 包拯拉著衛寧往裡走，公孫策抬腿跟了上去。
sentences.pinyin: bāo zhěng lā zhe wèi níng wǎng lǐ zǒu gōng sūn cè tái tuǐ gēn le shàng qù
sentences.english: Bao Zheng pulled Wei Ning inside, and Gongsun Ce quickly stepped forward to follow.

sentences.simplified: “去哪儿？你不是要见皇上吗？”卫宁好奇道。
sentences.traditional: “去哪兒？你不是要見皇上嗎？”衛寧好奇道。
sentences.pinyin: qù nǎ'r nǐ bú shì yào jiàn huáng shang ma wèi níng hào qí dào
sentences.english: “Where are we going? Weren’t you going to see the Emperor?” Wei Ning asked curiously.

sentences.simplified: “改变主意了，带我去你工作的侍卫营坐坐，我想向你借个本子看看。”
sentences.traditional: “改變主意了，帶我去你工作的侍衛營坐坐，我想向你借個本子看看。”
sentences.pinyin: gǎi biàn zhǔ yi le dài wǒ qù nǐ gōng zuò de shì wèi yíng zuò zuò wǒ xiǎng xiàng nǐ jiè ge běn zi kàn kan
sentences.english: “I’ve changed my mind. Take me to the imperial guard camp where you work. I want to borrow a notebook from you to have a look.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 13: A Bold Conjecture
Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce discovered a problem while looking over the records.
According to the records of the Department of Inner Palace Affairs, twenty-three people died in the fire at the Cold Palace.
However, according to the records of the Imperial Academy of Medicine, only twenty bodies were found.
Two women and one eunuch were missing.
Bao Zheng said: “When the fire broke out, Chu Zhu was probably in the Cold Palace.
If Chu Zhu was among the palace maids who died, then how could her hairpin appear on the uninhabited island?
Who was the woman who took the Eighth Prince to the uninhabited island?
Why did the Eighth Prince want to follow her to the uninhabited island?
Do they know each other? If they are acquainted, why would she kidnap the Eighth Prince?”
“Do you think it was the woman from the uninhabited island who kidnapped the Eighth Prince?” Gongsun Ce asked.
Bao Zheng nodded and said, “After seeing the hairpin and that letter, I believe it was that woman who kidnapped the Eighth Prince.”
Gongsun Ce thought for a moment and asked, “So, you suspect that Chu Zhu is not dead, and she is that woman?”
“It’s just a suspicion, without any evidence.
We can be even bolder in our conjecture that the two missing women from the fire are both still alive.”
One of them is Chu Zhu, and the other is the person buried in the unnamed grave on the uninhabited island.”
“Ah!” Gongsun Ce exclaimed, immediately saying, “There’s another possibility!”
“What?”
“There was also one eunuch missing from the bodies. The person buried in that grave could also be that eunuch!”
“There is only one room there. It was probably two women.”
“What you’re saying makes sense. Then where did the eunuch go?”
“Let’s go to the palace tomorrow to check the palace gate entry and exit records from that year. There might be some discoveries.”
The next day, Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce entered the palace gate.
This time, it wasn’t as smooth as the day before.
It seemed that the guards at the palace gate had received orders from someone not to let Bao Zheng enter the palace.
Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce talked for a long time, but the guards still didn’t agree to let them in.
Just when he didn’t know what to do, Bao Zheng saw a familiar face and felt a surge of joy.
“Lord Wei! Quick, come help!”
The chief imperial bodyguard, Wei Ning, happened to be passing by the palace gate when he heard Bao Zheng’s shouting.
He immediately came over.
“Lord Bao, what’s wrong?”
“Lord Wei, I need to see the emperor. Quick, bring me in!”
Wei Ning immediately understood what was going on.
He glanced at the guards and said loudly, “Lord Bao is working for the emperor. How dare you obstruct him?”
“It was Eunuch Zhang who told us to …” the guard explained in a low voice.
“Zhang Huai? Just because he told you to obstruct, you did? Are you serving Zhang Huai or the emperor?”
The guard was so scared that he was about to cry, and cold sweat immediately covered his head.
“Forget it, he had no choice either. Let’s go, take me somewhere else.”
Bao Zheng pulled Wei Ning inside, and Gongsun Ce quickly stepped forward to follow.
“Where are we going? Weren’t you going to see the Emperor?” Wei Ning asked curiously.
“I’ve changed my mind. Take me to the imperial guard camp where you work. I want to borrow a notebook from you to have a look.”
